name: Check HDD client config
command:
set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca bash -s <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
cd ~/Upload-Assistant-wastaken
python3 - <<'PY'
import ast
from pathlib import Path
cfg=ast.literal_eval(Path('docker-data/data/config.py').read_text().split('config:',1)[1].strip())
def show(name, value):
    print(f'{name}={value!r}')
default=cfg['DEFAULT']
for key in ('default_torrent_client','injecting_client_list','searching_client_list'):
    show(key, default.get(key))
for name, client in cfg.get('TORRENT_CLIENTS', {}).items():
    if not isinstance(client, dict):
        continue
    safe={key: client.get(key) for key in ('torrent_client','qbit_url','qbit_port','deluge_url','deluge_port','local_path','remote_path','torrent_storage_dir','qbit_cat') if key in client}
    show(f'client.{name}', safe)
PY
REMOTE
description: Review Destiny’s non-secret torrent-client settings after the HDD slot migration.
